# Error and warning reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm generate` from packages/schema/src/errors.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every failing command reports an error with a stable `code`, a `message`, an optional list of `issues`
(each with a `file` and a `path`), a `hint` and a `docs` link to this page.
With `--json` the error is the `error` field of the envelope on stdout.
`td2d explain <code>` prints any entry below, for errors and warnings alike.

## Exit codes

| Exit code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Success. Warnings may be present. |
| 1 | Unexpected internal error. This is a bug. |
| 2 | Usage error: unknown command or option, missing project, unknown id or name. |
| 3 | An input document is invalid. The error lists every issue with a file and a path. |
| 4 | Generation failed for a reason other than invalid input. |
| 5 | Generated output failed a validation check (with --strict, a warning too). The outputs were still written. |
| 6 | A batch finished but some assets failed. |
| 7 | The machine is missing something td2d needs. Run `td2d doctor`. |
| 130 | Cancelled by SIGINT or SIGTERM. |

## Errors

### E_INTERNAL

Exit code 1. Unexpected internal error.

Something td2d does not expect happened, such as an invalid built-in preset or an unhandled exception. It is a bug, not a problem with your files.

Fix: Re-run with --log-level debug and report the output.

More: [Internal errors](../guide/troubleshooting.md#internal-errors)

### E_USAGE

Exit code 2. Invalid command usage.

An unknown command, option or argument, an option value out of range, a malformed frame filter, a busy port for the viewer, or a combination of options that cannot work together.

Fix: Run `td2d <command> --help`.

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### E_PROJECT_NOT_FOUND

Exit code 2. No td2d project was found.

Commands look for td2d.project.json in the current directory and its parents, or in the directory --project names.

Fix: Run `td2d init <dir>` to create one, or pass --project <dir>.

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### E_PROJECT_EXISTS

Exit code 2. A td2d project already exists here.

`td2d init` found a td2d.project.json in the target directory.

Fix: Choose another directory.

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### E_INIT_CONFLICT

Exit code 2. Creating the project would overwrite existing files.

`td2d init` never replaces files; the details list the ones in the way.

Fix: Choose an empty directory or move the listed files.

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### E_ASSET_NOT_FOUND

Exit code 2. The asset does not exist.

No assets/<id>/asset.json (or asset script) exists for the id. Ids are paths below assets/, such as props/crate.

Fix: Run `td2d asset list` to see asset ids.

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### E_ASSET_EXISTS

Exit code 2. An asset with this id already exists.

`td2d asset create` and `td2d asset emit` do not replace an existing asset.json.

Fix: Choose another id or edit the existing asset.json.

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### E_NOT_GENERATED

Exit code 2. The asset has not been generated yet.

The command reads build/<id>/ (inspect, preview, compare, sheet, export, the viewer), and it has no manifest yet.

Fix: Run `td2d generate <id>` first.

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### E_SCHEMA_NOT_FOUND

Exit code 2. Unknown schema name.

`td2d schema <name>` takes one of the document names `td2d schema --list` prints.

Fix: Run `td2d schema --list` to see schema names.

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### E_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND

Exit code 2. Unknown template name.

`td2d init --template` and `td2d asset create --template` take a template that `td2d describe` lists.

Fix: Run `td2d describe` to list templates.

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### E_JSON_PARSE

Exit code 3. A file is not valid JSON.

td2d reads plain JSON: no comments, no trailing commas, double-quoted keys. The error names the file, line and column.

Fix: Fix the JSON syntax at the reported line and column. Comments and trailing commas are not allowed.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### E_PROJECT_INVALID

Exit code 3. td2d.project.json failed validation.

The project file has an unknown key, a wrong type or a missing field. Each issue gives its path.

Fix: Run `td2d schema project` to see the schema.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### E_ASSET_INVALID

Exit code 3. An asset definition failed validation.

The asset has an unknown key, a wrong type, a reference to a missing material, bone or clip, or settings that contradict each other. Each issue gives its file and path, such as model.parts[1].size.

Fix: Run `td2d schema asset` to see the schema.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### E_PRESET_NOT_FOUND

Exit code 3. A referenced preset does not exist.

A camera, lighting, pixel, sheet, export or rig setting names a preset that is neither built in nor in the project's presets/ directories.

Fix: Run `td2d describe` to list presets.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### E_PRESET_INVALID

Exit code 3. A preset file failed validation.

A file under presets/<kind>/ does not match that kind's schema. `td2d validate` lists every problem with its file.

Fix: Run `td2d schema <kind>-preset` to see the schema.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### E_PALETTE_NOT_FOUND

Exit code 3. A referenced palette does not exist.

`pixel.palette` names a palette that is neither built in nor in the project's palettes/ directories. Automatic palettes are written auto:<n>.

Fix: Run `td2d describe` to list palettes.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### E_PALETTE_INVALID

Exit code 3. A palette file failed validation.

A file under palettes/ does not match the palette schema: colours must be #rrggbb and names unique.

Fix: Run `td2d schema palette` to see the schema.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### E_PATH_OUTSIDE_PROJECT

Exit code 3. A path points outside the project root.

td2d reads and writes only inside the project. A path with ".." segments, an absolute path, or a symlink that leads out is refused.

Fix: Use paths relative to the project root without ".." segments or symlinks that leave the project.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### E_OUTPUT_DIR_NOT_EMPTY

Exit code 2. The output directory contains files that td2d did not write.

Commands that write to a directory you name (`td2d render --out`) only replace directories td2d created, which carry a .td2d-output marker.

Fix: Choose an empty directory, or one td2d created (it contains a .td2d-output marker).

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### E_MODEL_INVALID

Exit code 3. A model file could not be read.

The GLB given to `td2d render --glb` is missing, unreadable, not binary glTF, or failed to load in the renderer.

Fix: Check that the file is a binary glTF (.glb) and opens in a glTF viewer.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### E_PART_NOT_MANIFOLD

Exit code 3. A CSG operand is not a closed solid.

union, subtract and intersect need closed, watertight operands. Planes, lathes with open ends, and most imports are open surfaces.

Fix: Make each operand a closed shape (box, sphere, cylinder, capsule, or a lathe with closed ends), or place the parts in a group instead of combining them.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### E_COMPONENT_NOT_FOUND

Exit code 3. A referenced component does not exist.

A part of type component names a file that is not in the project's components/ directories.

Fix: Add components/<name>.json, or run `td2d describe` to list components.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### E_COMPONENT_INVALID

Exit code 3. A component file or its parameters are invalid.

The component file does not match its schema, a parameter is missing or has the wrong type, or a ${...} expression fails. Issues give the path inside the component.

Fix: Run `td2d schema component` to see the component format.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### E_COMPONENT_CYCLE

Exit code 3. Components include each other in a loop, or nest more than 8 deep.

Expanding components found one that includes itself, directly or through others, or nesting deeper than 8 levels.

Fix: Break the loop so no component includes itself, directly or indirectly.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### E_IMPORT_FAILED

Exit code 3. An imported model could not be read.

A part of type import names a file that is missing, larger than 50 MB, or not a valid GLB.

Fix: Check the src path, relative to the asset directory, and that the file is a valid GLB under 50 MB.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### E_MODEL_TOO_COMPLEX

Exit code 3. The model has more triangles than the limit.

The built model has more than 50,000 triangles. Sprites cannot show that detail, and rendering slows down.

Fix: Lower segment counts, simplify imports, or remove hidden detail. The limit is 50,000 triangles.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### E_SCRIPT_FAILED

Exit code 3. An asset script failed or printed an invalid definition.

`td2d asset emit` ran the script in a child process and it threw, timed out, or produced something that is not an asset definition.

Fix: Run the script with Node to see its error. Its default export must be an asset definition or a function returning one.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### E_SCRIPT_PERMISSION

Exit code 3. An asset script tried to do something asset scripts may not do.

td2d asset emit runs scripts with Node's permission model: they may read the project and the packages they import, and nothing else. Writing files, reading outside those directories, starting processes or workers, and loading native addons are refused, and nothing is written.

Fix: Compute the definition and return it from the default export; td2d writes it.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### E_GENERATION_FAILED

Exit code 4. Generation failed.

A stage could not finish for a reason other than invalid input: the built or rigged model failed glTF validation, geometry could not be merged, or a sheet needs more room than sheet.maxSize.

Fix: Inspect the error details, fix the asset, and run the command again.

More: [Rendering](../guide/troubleshooting.md#rendering)

### E_PARTIAL_PLAN

Exit code 2. A frame filter leaves out frames that are not in the cache, so the sheet cannot be completed.

`td2d generate --frames`, `--clips` or `--directions` renders only the matching samples and takes the rest from the cache; some of the rest have never been rendered.

Fix: Drop --frames, --clips or --directions once to render everything, then filter again.

More: [Caching, batches and cancellation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#caching-batches-and-cancellation)

### E_BACKEND_CRASHED

Exit code 4. The headless browser crashed during rendering, and again after a restart.

The render page crashed or the browser disconnected twice for the same asset. Running out of memory is the usual cause.

Fix: Run `td2d doctor`, then retry. Re-run with --log-level debug for browser output.

More: [Rendering](../guide/troubleshooting.md#rendering)

### E_BATCH_FAILED

Exit code 4. An asset in the batch failed, so the batch stopped.

Without --continue-on-error, a batch stops at the first failure. The report lists the failure and the assets that did not run.

Fix: Read build/batch-report.json. Use --continue-on-error to finish the other assets, then --resume to retry.

More: [Caching, batches and cancellation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#caching-batches-and-cancellation)

### E_ASSET_TIMEOUT

Exit code 4. An asset took longer than --timeout and was stopped.

With --timeout, each asset has a wall-clock limit. The asset that ran over is stopped and fails; a batch goes on to the next asset as it does for any failure.

Fix: Raise --timeout, or render fewer directions or frames while iterating.

More: [Caching, batches and cancellation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#caching-batches-and-cancellation)

### E_RENDER_FAILED

Exit code 4. Rendering failed.

The headless browser reported an error while drawing frames, or a render step timed out.

Fix: Re-run with --log-level debug to see browser console output.

More: [Rendering](../guide/troubleshooting.md#rendering)

### E_VALIDATION_FAILED

Exit code 5. Generated output failed validation.

A check in validation.json failed, or with --strict a check warned. The sprites and sheets were still written so you can look at them.

Fix: Read validation.json for the failing checks.

More: [Pixel output and validation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#pixel-output-and-validation)

### E_BATCH_PARTIAL

Exit code 6. Some assets in the batch failed.

With --continue-on-error (or several ids to generate), every asset ran and at least one failed. The others are written.

Fix: Read the batch report for per-asset errors.

More: [Caching, batches and cancellation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#caching-batches-and-cancellation)

### E_ENVIRONMENT

Exit code 7. The environment is missing something td2d needs.

`td2d doctor` found a failing check, such as a project directory td2d cannot write to.

Fix: Run `td2d doctor` for details.

More: [Environment and installation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#environment-and-installation)

### E_NODE_VERSION

Exit code 7. This Node.js version is not supported.

td2d needs Node.js 24 or newer for type stripping, recursive file watching and the permission model.

Fix: Install Node.js 24 or newer.

More: [Environment and installation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#environment-and-installation)

### E_BROWSER_MISSING

Exit code 7. The headless browser used for rendering is not installed.

Rendering runs in Playwright's headless Chromium, which is downloaded separately from npm packages.

Fix: Run `td2d doctor --fix` to install it.

More: [Environment and installation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#environment-and-installation)

### E_BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE

Exit code 7. The render backend cannot run on this machine.

The browser failed to start, WebGL2 is unavailable, the render harness is missing or a different version, or the backend id is unknown.

Fix: Run `td2d doctor` for details.

More: [Environment and installation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#environment-and-installation)

### E_NATIVE_MODULE

Exit code 7. A native module failed to load.

sharp or the manifold geometry module did not load, usually because dependencies were installed for another platform or architecture.

Fix: Reinstall dependencies for this platform and run `td2d doctor`.

More: [Environment and installation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#environment-and-installation)

### E_CANCELLED

Exit code 130. The operation was cancelled.

SIGINT (Ctrl+C) or SIGTERM arrived. td2d stopped its browser and workers and left no partial outputs; the cache keeps what finished.

Fix: Run the command again.

More: [Caching, batches and cancellation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#caching-batches-and-cancellation)

## Warnings

Warnings never change the exit code, except that `--strict` fails on validation warnings.

### W_OPACITY_THRESHOLDED

A material has opacity below 1, but the pixel stage makes alpha binary.

Fix: Use a solid colour, or dither, instead of partial opacity.

More: [Pixel output and validation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#pixel-output-and-validation)

### W_UNUSED_MATERIAL

A material is defined but no part uses it.

Fix: Remove the material, or check the part that should use it for a misspelt name.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### W_PRESET_SHADOWS_BUILTIN

A project preset has the same name as a built-in preset and replaces it.

Fix: Rename the project preset if the replacement is not intended.

More: [Asset definitions, presets and palettes](../guide/troubleshooting.md#asset-definitions-presets-and-palettes)

### W_NO_ASSETS

The project has no assets.

Fix: Run `td2d asset create <id> --template box`.

More: [Commands, projects and ids](../guide/troubleshooting.md#commands-projects-and-ids)

### W_HARDWARE_RENDERER

Rendering is not using the SwiftShader software rasteriser, so output may differ between machines.

Fix: Run `td2d doctor`; td2d launches Chromium with SwiftShader unless something overrides its flags.

More: [Rendering](../guide/troubleshooting.md#rendering)

### W_BLANK_FRAME

A rendered frame has no opaque pixels. The model may be outside the camera view.

Fix: Check the model is near the origin and above y = 0, and that pixelsPerUnit is not far too small.

More: [Rendering](../guide/troubleshooting.md#rendering)

### W_FRAME_CLIPPED

A rendered frame has opaque pixels on its edge, so the model is probably cut off.

Fix: Lower pixelsPerUnit (or set it to "auto"), enlarge the frame, or shrink the model.

More: [Rendering](../guide/troubleshooting.md#rendering)

### W_VALIDATOR_UNAVAILABLE

The glTF validator could not run, so the built model was not validated.

Fix: Reinstall dependencies; the model is still built and rendered.

More: [Environment and installation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#environment-and-installation)

### W_OUTPUT_CHECK

A generated sprite failed a non-fatal check. See validation.json.

Fix: Read validation.json for the check and the frames it names.

More: [Pixel output and validation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#pixel-output-and-validation)

### W_MODEL_OUT_OF_FRAME

The model is larger than the frame in some direction, so sprites will be cut off.

Fix: Lower pixelsPerUnit (or set it to "auto"), enlarge the frame, or shrink the model.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### W_MODEL_BELOW_GROUND

Part of the model is below y = 0, the ground.

Fix: Raise the parts so their base sits at y = 0; parts are centred on their position.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### W_TRIANGLE_BUDGET

The model has more than 20,000 triangles, which slows rendering without adding visible detail.

Fix: Lower segment counts or simplify imports.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### W_DEGENERATE_TRIANGLES

The model has zero-area triangles.

Fix: Look for parts with a zero size or zero radius.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### W_OPEN_MESH

A part is not a closed surface, so it may show holes or render inside-out faces.

Fix: Prefer closed shapes. A plane or an open lathe is fine where its back is never seen.

More: [Models, components and imports](../guide/troubleshooting.md#models-components-and-imports)

### W_COMPOSITION_GROUND

A sprite does not reach the ground line, so the model floats above its pivot.

Fix: Put the model's base at y = 0, or set camera.groundMargin to "auto".

More: [Pixel output and validation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#pixel-output-and-validation)

### W_COMPOSITION_EDGE

A sprite touches the frame edge, so it is probably cut off.

Fix: Lower pixelsPerUnit (or set it to "auto"), or enlarge the frame.

More: [Pixel output and validation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#pixel-output-and-validation)

### W_INDEXED_UNAVAILABLE

An indexed PNG was requested but the image needs more than 256 palette entries, so it was written as RGBA.

Fix: Set a palette (fixed or auto:<n>) so sprites use at most 256 colours.

More: [Pixel output and validation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#pixel-output-and-validation)

### W_CLIP_FRAME_PERIOD

A clip duration is not a whole number of frames, so it plays at a slightly different frame rate.

Fix: Make duration times fps a whole number.

More: [Rigs and animation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#rigs-and-animation)

### W_CLIP_BONE_LIMIT

A clip turns a bone further than the limits declared in the rig.

Fix: Reduce the rotation in the named key, or widen the bone's limits in the rig.

More: [Rigs and animation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#rigs-and-animation)

### W_CLIP_FOOT_CONTACT

In a walk-cycle clip the feet leave the ground or sink into it by more than a pixel.

Fix: Set the walk-cycle bob the warning suggests.

More: [Rigs and animation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#rigs-and-animation)

### W_BACKEND_RESTARTED

The headless browser crashed (E_BACKEND_CRASHED) and was restarted; the retry succeeded.

Fix: Outputs are complete. Repeated restarts usually mean too little memory: lower --concurrency.

More: [Rendering](../guide/troubleshooting.md#rendering)

### W_CACHE_PRUNED

The cache grew past its size limit, so the least recently used entries were removed.

Fix: Raise cache.maxSize in td2d.project.json if entries you need keep being removed.

More: [Caching, batches and cancellation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#caching-batches-and-cancellation)

### W_MEMORY_HIGH

td2d's memory use passed the warning level during a stage.

Fix: Lower td2d batch --concurrency or render fewer frames at once. TD2D_MEMORY_WARN_MB sets the level.

More: [Caching, batches and cancellation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#caching-batches-and-cancellation)

### W_PALETTE_PER_CLIP

Each clip has its own automatic palette, so colours can jump where one clip hands over to another.

Fix: Use paletteScope "asset" (the default) unless clips never play next to each other.

More: [Pixel output and validation](../guide/troubleshooting.md#pixel-output-and-validation)
